stand.prompt:
Create a production PIXEL ART ANIMATION POSE SHEET for a 1990s sports-broadcast game. References: image1 is the APPROVED Gerard identity (elongated clean-shaven face, thin round glasses, wavy brown hair, gray temples, warm quirky 48-year-old geek, blue headset, lemon/red-flower blue Hawaiian shirt, dark tee). Image2 supplies only Rene Le Chevalier's identity and clothes (older silver hair, rectangular glasses, discreet gray mustache, blue blazer, navy tie). Preserve these identities.

CRITICAL NEW ART DIRECTION: Deliberately low-resolution hand-clustered pixel art, designed at 384x128 logical pixels PER DUO FRAME. Large clean contiguous flat color clusters. Faces use only 4 warm skin shades, NO dithering, no stipple, no skin texture, no scattered highlight pixels, no fine wrinkle hatch. Age comes from silhouette, ONE cheek fold and ONE brow crease, not many lines. Eyes small and narrow, upper eyelids low as they look down; only a tiny off-white sliver visible, never blue sclera, no huge whites. Hair 3 large tones, shirt pattern simplified broad lemons. Crisp stair steps. Do not paint high-detail faces then pixelate.

OUTPUT: one sheet EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, EIGHT equal 3:1 landscape frames, row-major order. No gutters, no margins, no labels or text. Each frame same locked straight-on camera: Gerard entirely in LEFT HALF, Le Chevalier entirely RIGHT HALF, no overlapping at center. Flat solid #081522 background, thin horizontal dark-blue desk along bottom at IDENTICAL height. Each duo frame identical scales and camera. Make the final sheet 1536x1024 if possible (each frame 768x256).
This sheet is for STANDING REACTION with more inbetweens, not a dance. The rink is DOWN BELOW camera. Gerard reacts passionately to the rink, never to audience.
1: both sitting, Gerard quietly intent looking down, Rene looking down at rink, resting hands.
2: Gerard leans forward palms on desk starting to push up, gaze down, mouth small surprised O; Rene STILL looks down, oblivious.
3: Gerard rises halfway, shoulders higher, looks DOWN at rink. Rene only moves eyes left, head still down, just noticing.
4: Gerard FULLY STANDING, head and neck extend OUT OF TOP of frame, torso visible, bent arms excited at chest height. Rene begins to turn face left with surprised small O mouth, NOT already craning head.
5: Gerard remains fully standing, EXACT same torso/head crop as4, raises forearms just a LITTLE (subtle excited movement, not waving). Rene now raises chin and looks UP-LEFT at Gerard's offscreen face.
6: Gerard remains fully standing, EXACT same torso, forearms settle slightly lower than5. Rene continues looking UP-LEFT, closes surprised mouth, bemused.
7: Gerard halfway sitting down, pleased but modest closed mouth, eyes down toward rink; Rene still chin raised tracking him, beginning down.
8: both seated in exact initial positions, small relaxed expression, looking down at rink.

Do not give Gerard a beard or mustache. Angular mature hands, coherent five fingers. Restrained facial detail is more important than texture. Standing must clearly exit the top; never shrink Gerard to fit the frame.
